newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangzhou Inv amends spinoff offer.
newsitem.headline: Guangzhou Inv amends spinoff offer.

text.p: Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd said on Thursday it had changed its preferential offer of GZI Transport Ltd shares to its shareholders to a proportion of one GZI Transport share for every 52 Guangzhou Investment shares held.
Guangzhou Investment said it changed the proporation to 52:1 from 51:1 due to the increase in the number of shares held by its shareholders.
Guangzhou Investment also said its shareholders had approved the spinoff of GZI Transport in an extraordinary general meeting held on Wednesday.

GZI Transport, which holds the parent's infrastructural projects in China, will offer new shares with warrants in the proportion of one GZI Transport warrant for every five GZI Transport shares to institutional investors and through public offer in Hong Kong.
The public offer includes a preferential offer to Guangzhou Investment shareholders.
GZI Transport has six toll road projects, mainly in China's southern Guangdong province.
